}}'''Yanet''' was a woman from the [[Age of Legends]] who was murdered by [[Graendal]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Yanet}} It can be assumed that [[Lews Therin Telamon]] held some affection for her, although nothing else is known of her.

== Present time ==
Millennia later Graendal is worried that [[Rand al'Thor]], Lews Therin's incarnation, will remember her killing Yanet.{{ref/book|13|p}}
